fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-12-08, around 09:50, the complainant reported losing Rs. 60,000 on an online betting platform allegedly promoted by a local agent, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-12-09. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Arjun Shankar, using the number 9000000136. Nithya Rani (9000000035) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents and social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Local agent allegedly promoted a betting platform and collected deposits.
fields.Keywords: online betting, gambling, suspect, digital document, morning, witness, mobile number, screenshot
